title: Annotated Permission Ticket
subtitle: A SMART Permission Ticket with inline explanations of each field and section.

annotations.title: JWT Envelope
annotations.body: Standard JWT claims that identify who minted the ticket, who it is intended for, how long it lasts, which instance this is, and which profile the Data Holder should apply.

fields./exp: Expiration: Unix timestamp after which this ticket is invalid
fields./ticket_type: Profile URI telling the Data Holder which validation rules to apply

annotations.title: Presenter Binding
annotations.body: Binds redemption to the client that holds the private key corresponding to the JWK thumbprint. The Data Holder verifies a DPoP-like proof at redemption time.

fields./presenter_binding/jkt: JWK thumbprint of the client's public key

annotations.title: Subject
annotations.body: Identifies whose data the ticket is about. Carries a thin FHIR Patient resource with enough demographic detail for the Data Holder to match against its records.

annotations.title: Access
annotations.body: The authorization payload. Declares what the client may do after the ticket is redeemed: which FHIR resource types and which interactions (read, search, etc.).

fields./access/permissions/0/kind: Permission category: "data" means FHIR resource access
fields./access/permissions/0/resource_type: FHIR resource type this grant covers
